P4 TE Model
```{r}
# --- 0. Load Libraries ---
library(dplyr)
library(randomForest)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)
library(pROC)
library(car)

set.seed(42)

# Change all column names from underscores to dots
colnames(te_full_fbs) <- gsub(".", "", colnames(te_full_fbs))

# Verify the changes
colnames(te_full_fbs)


# --- 1. Use raw TE dataset (no feature engineering) ---
te_data <- te_full_fbs %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "P4") %>%
  mutate(Row_ID = row_number())

#te_data <- te_data %>%
 # filter(Receiving_Snaps >= 150)


# --- 2. Save Identifiers ---
player_info <- te_data %>% select(Row_ID, Name, Team, Season, All_Con)

# --- 3. Select Only Numeric Features ---
drop_cols <- c(
  "Player.Id", "Name", "Team", "Team.x", "Team.y", "Team.Name", "Team.Name.x", "Team.Name.y",
  "Conference", "Conference.x", "Conference.y", "Conference_Level",
  "Position", "Jersey.Number", "Jersey.Number.x", "Jersey.Number.y",
  "Player.College.GSIS", "Player.College.GSIS.x", "Player.College.GSIS.y",
  "Season", "Games.Won", "Player_Id", "Key_Plays", "Receiving_Snaps", 
  "Explosive_Plays", "Offensive_Snaps", "Player_ID", "Jersey_Number", 
  "Player_College_GSIS"
)

# Keep only numeric columns + handle NAs
df_numeric_base <- te_data %>%
  select(-any_of(drop_cols)) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Attach All_Con and Row_ID
df_clean <- df_numeric_base %>%
  mutate(All_Con = te_data$All_Con, Row_ID = te_data$Row_ID)

# --- 4. Separate Predictors ---
df_predictors <- df_clean %>% select(-All_Con, -Row_ID)

# --- 5. Remove Zero-Variance Columns ---
zero_var_cols <- sapply(df_predictors, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)
df_numeric <- df_predictors[, !zero_var_cols, drop = FALSE]

# --- 6. Drop Corrupted/Bad Correlation Columns ---
cor_matrix <- cor(df_numeric, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
bad_cols <- colnames(cor_matrix)[apply(cor_matrix, 2, function(x) any(is.na(x) | is.nan(x)))]
df_numeric <- df_numeric %>% select(-any_of(bad_cols))

# --- 7. Reattach Labels ---
df_numeric$All_Con <- df_clean$All_Con[1:nrow(df_numeric)]
df_numeric$Row_ID  <- df_clean$Row_ID[1:nrow(df_numeric)]

# --- 8. Remove Highly Correlated Features ---
cor_matrix <- cor(df_numeric %>% select(-All_Con, -Row_ID))
high_cor   <- findCorrelation(cor_matrix, cutoff = 0.7)
df_final   <- df_numeric %>% select(-all_of(names(cor_matrix)[high_cor]), All_Con, Row_ID)

# --- 9. Remove Multicollinearity via VIF ---
reduce_vif <- function(df, threshold = 5) {
  y <- df$All_Con
  ids <- df$Row_ID
  X <- df %>% select(-All_Con, -Row_ID)

  qr_decomp <- qr(as.matrix(X))
  indep_cols <- qr_decomp$pivot[1:qr_decomp$rank]
  X_clean <- X[, indep_cols, drop = FALSE]
  df_clean <- cbind(X_clean, All_Con = y, Row_ID = ids)

  repeat {
    model <- glm(All_Con ~ ., data = df_clean %>% select(-Row_ID), family = binomial)
    vifs <- vif(model)
    if (max(vifs) < threshold) break
    df_clean <- df_clean %>% select(-which.max(vifs))
  }
  return(df_clean)
}

df_final_vif <- reduce_vif(df_final)
df_final_vif <- na.omit(df_final_vif)

# --- 10. Train/Test Split ---
train_index <- createDataPartition(df_final_vif$All_Con, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data  <- df_final_vif[train_index, ]
test_data   <- df_final_vif[-train_index, ]

# --- 11. Train Random Forest Model ---
rf_model <- randomForest(as.factor(All_Con) ~ ., 
                         data = train_data %>% select(-Row_ID), 
                         ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)

# --- 12. Predict & Grade ---
pred_test_prob <- predict(rf_model, test_data, type = "prob")
test_data$Composite_Score <- pred_test_prob[, 2]

test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.90) ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.75) ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.50) ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.25) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 13. Merge Back with Names ---
test_data_named <- test_data %>% left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID")

# --- 14. Output Top Players ---
player_grades <- test_data_named %>%
  select(Name, Team, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

print(head(player_grades, 20))

# --- 15. Visualizations ---
ggplot(test_data, aes(x = Player_Grade)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of TE Grades", x = "Grade", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(test_data, aes(x = Composite_Score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, fill = "darkorange", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "TE Composite Score Distribution", x = "Score", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

#roc_obj <- roc(test_data$All_Con, test_data$Composite_Score)
#plot(roc_obj, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curve - All_Con")
#cat("AUC:", auc(roc_obj), "\n")

importance_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(importance(rf_model)),
  Importance = importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = reorder(Feature, Importance), y = Importance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Feature Importance - P4 TE Model", x = "Feature", y = "MeanDecreaseGini") +
  theme_minimal()

# --- 16. Evaluation Metrics ---
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(predict(rf_model, test_data), as.factor(test_data$All_Con))

calc_metrics <- function(cm) {
  TP <- cm$table[2, 2]
  TN <- cm$table[1, 1]
  FP <- cm$table[1, 2]
  FN <- cm$table[2, 1]

  accuracy <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
  precision <- if ((TP + FP) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FP)
  recall <- if ((TP + FN) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FN)
  specificity <- if ((TN + FP) == 0) NA else TN / (TN + FP)
  balanced_accuracy <- mean(c(recall, specificity), na.rm = TRUE)
  f1_score <- if ((precision + recall) == 0 || is.na(precision + recall)) NA else 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)

  tibble(
    Accuracy = as.numeric(accuracy),
    Precision = precision,
    Recall = recall,
    Specificity = specificity,
    Balanced_Accuracy = balanced_accuracy,
    F1_Score = f1_score
  )
}

calc_metrics(conf_matrix)

# --- 17. Predict for full dataset ---
full_pred_prob <- predict(rf_model, df_final_vif %>% select(-Row_ID, -All_Con), type = "prob")
df_final_vif$Composite_Score <- full_pred_prob[, 2]

# Merge back with original player info
full_data_with_info <- df_final_vif %>%
  left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID")

# Assign grades based on quantiles
full_data_with_info <- full_data_with_info %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Filter for 2024 Players ---
players_2024 <- full_data_with_info %>%
  filter(Season == 2025) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Season, Composite_Score, Player_Grade)

print(players_2024)
View(players_2024)

players_2024_stats <- full_data_with_info %>%
  filter(Season == 2025) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Player_Grade, Composite_Score, everything(), -Row_ID)

View(players_2024_stats)
print(players_2024_stats)

```

P4 Week 1
```{r}
# --- P4 Week 1 TE Grading (Complete Features with All Stats) ---

# Correct way to change dots to underscores
colnames(te_combined_week1_2024) <- gsub("\\.", "_", colnames(te_combined_week1_2024))

colnames(offensive_summary_week1_2024) <- gsub("\\.", "_", colnames(offensive_summary_week1_2024))

# Verify the changes
colnames(te_combined_week1_2024)
colnames(offensive_summary_week1_2024)

# First filter for P4 TEs with at least 10 offensive snaps
p4_te_week1_2024 <- te_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "P4", 
         Position == "TE", 
         Offensive_Snaps > 10)

cat("Number of TEs after filtering:", nrow(p4_te_week1_2024), "\n")
glimpse(p4_te_week1_2024)

# --- Add Offensive Snaps and Grades from Summary ---
te_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "TE") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive_Snaps, Offensive_Grade, Passblock_Grade, Runblock_Grade)

# Join snaps and grades to TE data
p4_te_week1_2024 <- p4_te_week1_2024 %>%
  left_join(te_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Check if Offensive_Snaps was added and rename if needed
if ("Offensive_Snaps.x" %in% colnames(p4_te_week1_2024)) {
  p4_te_week1_2024 <- p4_te_week1_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive_Snaps = coalesce(Offensive_Snaps.x, Offensive_Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive_Snaps.x, -Offensive_Snaps.y)
}

# If Offensive_Snaps doesn't exist, create it
if (!"Offensive_Snaps" %in% colnames(p4_te_week1_2024)) {
  p4_te_week1_2024$Offensive_Snaps <- NA
  cat("Created Offensive_Snaps column with NAs\n")
}

# --- TE Weighted Grading Model (Complete Features) ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (Complete TE Model) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP FEATURES (3X Multiplier) ---
  "Receiving_Yards_after_Contract" = 37.4296314 * 3,
  "Yards_per_Route_Run" = 16.0911051 * 3,
  "Receiving_Touchdowns" = 15.3134390 * 3,
  "Offensive_Grade" = 14.6816592 * 3,
  "Contested_Catches" = 14.5988965 * 3,
  "Missed_Tackles_forced_on_Receptions" = 14.5508964 * 3,
  
  # --- NEXT TIER FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Snaps_on_Press_Coverage" = 13.6860371 * 1.5,
  "Passblock_Grade" = 12.5353405 * 1.5,
  "Average_Depth_of_Target" = 12.3696757 * 1.5,
  "Runblock_Grade" = 12.0060564 * 1.5,
  "Passer_Rating_when_Targetted" = 11.0593491 * 1.5,
  "Yards_After_Catch_per_Reception" = 10.6142461 * 1.5,
  
  # --- REMAINING FEATURES ---
  "Dropped_Passes" = 7.4734004,
  "Fumbles" = 1.9446846,
  "Fumbles_Lost" = 0.8646018,
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving_Snaps" = 2,
  "Targets" = 20,
  "Receptions" = 50,
  "Receiving_Yards" = 100,
  "Receiving_First_Downs" = 50,
  "Catchable_Targets" = 3,
  "Contested_Targets" = 5,
  "Contested_Catches_Percentage" = 4,
  "Slot_Target_Percentage" = 2,
  "Deep_Target_Percentage" = 3,
  "Completion_Percentage_when_Targeted" = 4,
  "Explosive_Plays" = 6,
  "Percentage_of_Catchable_Passes_Caught" = 3,
  "Dropped_Catchable_Passes_Percentage" = -4,
  "Percentage_of_Targets_per_Receiving_Snaps" = 3,
  
  # --- BLOCKING METRICS (Important for TEs) ---
  "Passblock_Grade" = 50,
  "Runblock_Grade" = 50
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to TE dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(p4_te_week1_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(p4_te_week1_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
te_input_all <- p4_te_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
te_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(te_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(te_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  te_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---

  mutate(

      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",

  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))
```

```{r}
  g5_te_week1_2024$Offensive_Snaps <- NA
  cat("Created Offensive_Snaps column with NAs\n")
}

# --- TE Weighted Grading Model (Complete Features) ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (Complete TE Model for G5) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP FEATURES (3X Multiplier) ---
  "Receiving_Yards_after_Contact" = 21.7696558 * 3,
  "Receiving_Touchdowns" = 17.2941714 * 3,
  "Contested_Targets" = 16.2007913 * 3,
  "Offensive_Grade" = 15.6440136 * 3,
  "Snaps_on_Press_Coverage" = 13.4688914 * 3,
  "Yards_per_Route_Run" = 11.9507703 * 3,
  
  # --- NEXT TIER FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Runblock_Grade" = 11.4946460 * 1.5,
  "Passer_Rating_when_Targetted" = 11.3784135 * 1.5,
  "Missed_Tackles_forced_on_Receptions" = 10.4252060 * 1.5,
  "Passblock_Grade" = 9.3267522 * 1.5,
  "Yards_After_Catch_per_Reception" = 8.9767297 * 1.5,
  "Average_Depth_of_Target" = 8.7911050 * 1.5,
  
  # --- REMAINING FEATURES ---
  "Contested_Catches" = 6.0161386,
  "Dropped_Passes" = 4.3571449,
  "Fumbles" = 1.1168613,
  "Fumbles_Lost" = 0.7991708,
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving_Snaps" = 2,
  "Targets" = 20,
  "Receptions" = 50,
  "Receiving_Yards" = 100,
  "Receiving_First_Downs" = 50,

  "Contested_Catches_Percentage" = 4,
  "Slot_Target_Percentage" = 2,
  "Deep_Target_Percentage" = 3,
  "Completion_Percentage_when_Targeted" = 4,
  "Explosive_Plays" = 6,
  "Percentage_of_Catchable_Passes_Caught" = 3,
  "Dropped_Catchable_Passes_Percentage" = -4,
  "Percentage_of_Targets_per_Receiving_Snaps" = 3,
  
  # --- BLOCKING METRICS (Important for TEs) ---
  "Passblock_Grade" = 50,
  "Runblock_Grade" = 50
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}
```

```{r}
  filter(!Team %in% c("NOTRE DAME", "UMASS", "UCONN", "AIR FORCE", "ARMY", "NAVY"))

# First filter for G5 TEs with at least 10 offensive snaps
g5_te_week2_2024 <- te_combined_week2_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "G5", 
         Position == "TE", 
         Offensive_Snaps > 10)

cat("Number of TEs after filtering:", nrow(g5_te_week2_2024), "\n")
glimpse(g5_te_week2_2024)

# --- Add Offensive Snaps and Grades from Summary ---
te_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week2_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "TE") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive_Snaps, Offensive_Grade, Passblock_Grade, Runblock_Grade)

# Join snaps and grades to TE data
g5_te_week2_2024 <- g5_te_week2_2024 %>%
  left_join(te_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Check if Offensive_Snaps was added and rename if needed
if ("Offensive_Snaps.x" %in% colnames(g5_te_week2_2024)) {
  g5_te_week2_2024 <- g5_te_week2_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive_Snaps = coalesce(Offensive_Snaps.x, Offensive_Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive_Snaps.x, -Offensive_Snaps.y)
}

# If Offensive_Snaps doesn't exist, create it
if (!"Offensive_Snaps" %in% colnames(g5_te_week2_2024)) {
  g5_te_week2_2024$Offensive_Snaps <- NA
  cat("Created Offensive_Snaps column with NAs\n")
}

# --- TE Weighted Grading Model (Complete Features) ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (Complete TE Model for G5) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP FEATURES (3X Multiplier) ---
  "Receiving_Yards_after_Contact" = 21.7696558 * 3,
  "Receiving_Touchdowns" = 17.2941714 * 3,
  "Contested_Targets" = 16.2007913 * 3,
  "Offensive_Grade" = 15.6440136 * 3,
  "Snaps_on_Press_Coverage" = 13.4688914 * 3,
  "Yards_per_Route_Run" = 11.9507703 * 3,
  
  # --- NEXT TIER FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Runblock_Grade" = 11.4946460 * 1.5,
  "Passer_Rating_when_Targetted" = 11.3784135 * 1.5,
  "Missed_Tackles_forced_on_Receptions" = 10.4252060 * 1.5,
  "Passblock_Grade" = 9.3267522 * 1.5,
  "Yards_After_Catch_per_Reception" = 8.9767297 * 1.5,
  "Average_Depth_of_Target" = 8.7911050 * 1.5,
  
  # --- REMAINING FEATURES ---
  "Contested_Catches" = 6.0161386,
  "Dropped_Passes" = 4.3571449,
  "Fumbles" = 1.1168613,
  "Fumbles_Lost" = 0.7991708,
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving_Snaps" = 2,
  "Targets" = 20,
  "Receptions" = 50,
  "Receiving_Yards" = 100,
  "Receiving_First_Downs" = 50,
  "Catchable_Targets" = 3,
  "Contested_Catches_Percentage" = 4,
  "Slot_Target_Percentage" = 2,
  "Deep_Target_Percentage" = 3,
  "Completion_Percentage_when_Targeted" = 4,
  "Explosive_Plays" = 6,
  "Percentage_of_Catchable_Passes_Caught" = 3,
  "Dropped_Catchable_Passes_Percentage" = -4,
  "Percentage_of_Targets_per_Receiving_Snaps" = 3,
  
  # --- BLOCKING METRICS (Important for TEs) ---
  "Passblock_Grade" = 50,
  "Runblock_Grade" = 50
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to TE dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(g5_te_week2_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(g5_te_week2_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
te_input_all <- g5_te_week2_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
te_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(te_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(te_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  te_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---
te_full_view <- te_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    Offensive_Grade, Passblock_Grade, Runblock_Grade,
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
te_eval_summary <- te_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== G5 TE WEEK 2 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(te_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(te_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 TEs ===\n")
print(head(te_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(te_eval_summary)
View(te_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats (all columns)
write.csv(
  te_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 2/G5/G5 TE Full Stats Week 2.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  te_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 2/G5/G5 TE Week 2 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. G5 TE Full Stats Week 2.csv (ALL stats included)\n")
cat("2. G5 TE Week 2 Grade 2024.csv (Summary with Composite Score & Grade)\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total TEs evaluated:", nrow(te_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- te_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(te_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to TE dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(g5_te_week3_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(g5_te_week3_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
te_input_all <- g5_te_week3_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
te_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(te_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(te_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  te_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---
te_full_view <- te_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    Offensive_Grade, Passblock_Grade, Runblock_Grade,
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
te_eval_summary <- te_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== G5 TE WEEK 3 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(te_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(te_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 TEs ===\n")
print(head(te_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(te_eval_summary)
View(te_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats (all columns)
write.csv(
  te_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 3/G5/G5 TE Full Stats Week 3.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  te_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 3/G5/G5 TE Week 3 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. G5 TE Full Stats Week 3.csv (ALL stats included)\n")
cat("2. G5 TE Week 3 Grade 2024.csv (Summary with Composite Score & Grade)\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total TEs evaluated:", nrow(te_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- te_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(te_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
cat("Number of TEs after filtering:", nrow(p4_te_week5_2024), "\n")
glimpse(p4_te_week5_2024)

# --- Add Offensive Snaps and Grades from Summary ---
te_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week5_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "TE") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive_Snaps, Offensive_Grade, Passblock_Grade, Runblock_Grade)

# Join snaps and grades to TE data
p4_te_week5_2024 <- p4_te_week5_2024 %>%
  left_join(te_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Check if Offensive_Snaps was added and rename if needed
if ("Offensive_Snaps.x" %in% colnames(p4_te_week5_2024)) {
  p4_te_week5_2024 <- p4_te_week5_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive_Snaps = coalesce(Offensive_Snaps.x, Offensive_Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive_Snaps.x, -Offensive_Snaps.y)
}

# If Offensive_Snaps doesn't exist, create it
if (!"Offensive_Snaps" %in% colnames(p4_te_week5_2024)) {
  p4_te_week5_2024$Offensive_Snaps <- NA
  cat("Created Offensive_Snaps column with NAs\n")
}

# --- TE Weighted Grading Model (Complete Features) ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (Complete TE Model) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP FEATURES (3X Multiplier) ---
  "Receiving_Yards_after_Contact" = 37.4296314 * 3,
  "Yards_per_Route_Run" = 16.0911051 * 3,
  "Receiving_Touchdowns" = 15.3134390 * 3,
  "Offensive_Grade" = 14.6816592 * 3,
  "Contested_Catches" = 14.5988965 * 3,
  "Missed_Tackles_forced_on_Receptions" = 14.5508964 * 3,
  
  # --- NEXT TIER FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Snaps_on_Press_Coverage" = 13.6860371 * 1.5,
  "Passblock_Grade" = 12.5353405 * 1.5,
  "Average_Depth_of_Target" = 12.3696757 * 1.5,
  "Runblock_Grade" = 12.0060564 * 1.5,
  "Passer_Rating_when_Targetted" = 11.0593491 * 1.5,
  "Yards_After_Catch_per_Reception" = 10.6142461 * 1.5,
  
  # --- REMAINING FEATURES ---
  "Dropped_Passes" = 7.4734004,
  "Fumbles" = 1.9446846,
  "Fumbles_Lost" = 0.8646018,
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving_Snaps" = 2,
  "Targets" = 20,
  "Receptions" = 50,
  "Receiving_Yards" = 100,
  "Receiving_First_Downs" = 50,
  "Catchable_Targets" = 3,
  "Contested_Targets" = 5,
  "Contested_Catches_Percentage" = 4,
  "Slot_Target_Percentage" = 2,
  "Deep_Target_Percentage" = 3,
  "Completion_Percentage_when_Targeted" = 4,
  "Explosive_Plays" = 6,
  "Percentage_of_Catchable_Passes_Caught" = 3,
  "Dropped_Catchable_Passes_Percentage" = -4,
  "Percentage_of_Targets_per_Receiving_Snaps" = 3,
  
  # --- BLOCKING METRICS (Important for TEs) ---
  "Passblock_Grade" = 50,
  "Runblock_Grade" = 50
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to TE dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(p4_te_week5_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(p4_te_week5_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
te_input_all <- p4_te_week5_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
te_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(te_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(te_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  te_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---
te_full_view <- te_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    Offensive_Grade, Passblock_Grade, Runblock_Grade,
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
te_eval_summary <- te_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---

cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(te_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")

cat("\n=== TOP 10 TEs ===\n")

# --- 11. Save Files ---

  te_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 5/P4/P4 TE Full Stats Week 5.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
  p4_te_week6_2024$Offensive_Snaps <- NA
  cat("Created Offensive_Snaps column with NAs\n")
}

# --- TE Weighted Grading Model (Complete Features) ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (Complete TE Model) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP FEATURES (3X Multiplier) ---
  "Receiving_Yards_after_Contact" = 37.4296314 * 3,
  "Yards_per_Route_Run" = 16.0911051 * 3,
  "Receiving_Touchdowns" = 15.3134390 * 3,
  "Offensive_Grade" = 14.6816592 * 3,
  "Contested_Catches" = 14.5988965 * 3,
  "Missed_Tackles_forced_on_Receptions" = 14.5508964 * 3,
  
  # --- NEXT TIER FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Snaps_on_Press_Coverage" = 13.6860371 * 1.5,
  "Passblock_Grade" = 12.5353405 * 1.5,
  "Average_Depth_of_Target" = 12.3696757 * 1.5,
  "Runblock_Grade" = 12.0060564 * 1.5,
  "Passer_Rating_when_Targetted" = 11.0593491 * 1.5,
  "Yards_After_Catch_per_Reception" = 10.6142461 * 1.5,
  
  # --- REMAINING FEATURES ---
  "Dropped_Passes" = 7.4734004,
  "Fumbles" = 1.9446846,
  "Fumbles_Lost" = 0.8646018,
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving_Snaps" = 2,
  "Targets" = 20,
  "Receptions" = 50,
  "Receiving_Yards" = 100,
  "Receiving_First_Downs" = 50,
  "Catchable_Targets" = 3,
  "Contested_Targets" = 5,
  "Contested_Catches_Percentage" = 4,
  "Slot_Target_Percentage" = 2,
  "Deep_Target_Percentage" = 3,
  "Completion_Percentage_when_Targeted" = 4,
  "Explosive_Plays" = 6,
  "Percentage_of_Catchable_Passes_Caught" = 3,
  "Dropped_Catchable_Passes_Percentage" = -4,
  "Percentage_of_Targets_per_Receiving_Snaps" = 3,
  
  # --- BLOCKING METRICS (Important for TEs) ---
  "Passblock_Grade" = 50,
  "Runblock_Grade" = 50
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to TE dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(p4_te_week6_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(p4_te_week6_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
te_input_all <- p4_te_week6_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
te_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(te_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(te_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  te_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---
te_full_view <- te_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    Offensive_Grade, Passblock_Grade, Runblock_Grade,
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
te_eval_summary <- te_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== P4 TE WEEK 6 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(te_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(te_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 TEs ===\n")
print(head(te_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(te_eval_summary)
View(te_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats (all columns)
write.csv(
  te_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 6/P4/P4 TE Full Stats Week 6.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  te_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 6/P4/P4 TE Week 6 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. P4 TE Full Stats Week 6.csv (ALL stats included)\n")
cat("2. P4 TE Week 6 Grade 2024.csv (Summary with Composite Score & Grade)\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total TEs evaluated:", nrow(te_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- te_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(te_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to TE dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
```

```{r}
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
te_input_all <- p4_te_week7_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
te_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(te_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(te_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  te_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---

  select(

    Offensive_Grade, Passblock_Grade, Runblock_Grade,

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---

  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
```

```{r}
  # --- BLOCKING METRICS (Important for TEs) ---

)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}
```

```{r}
# --- G5 Week 8 TE Grading (Complete Features with All Stats) ---

# Correct way to change dots to underscores

colnames(offensive_summary_week8_2024) <- gsub("\\.", "_", colnames(offensive_summary_week8_2024))

# Verify the changes
colnames(te_combined_week8_2024)

# Remove NOTRE DAME, UMASS, UCONN, AIR FORCE, ARMY, NAVY
te_combined_week8_2024 <- te_combined_week8_2024 %>%
  filter(!Team %in% c("NOTRE DAME", "UMASS", "UCONN", "AIR FORCE", "ARMY", "NAVY"))

# First filter for G5 TEs with at least 10 offensive snaps
g5_te_week8_2024 <- te_combined_week8_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "G5", 
         Position == "TE", 
         Offensive_Snaps > 10)

cat("Number of TEs after filtering:", nrow(g5_te_week8_2024), "\n")
glimpse(g5_te_week8_2024)

# --- Add Offensive Snaps and Grades from Summary ---
te_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week8_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "TE") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive_Snaps, Offensive_Grade, Passblock_Grade, Runblock_Grade)

# Join snaps and grades to TE data
g5_te_week8_2024 <- g5_te_week8_2024 %>%
  left_join(te_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Check if Offensive_Snaps was added and rename if needed
if ("Offensive_Snaps.x" %in% colnames(g5_te_week8_2024)) {
  g5_te_week8_2024 <- g5_te_week8_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive_Snaps = coalesce(Offensive_Snaps.x, Offensive_Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive_Snaps.x, -Offensive_Snaps.y)
}

# If Offensive_Snaps doesn't exist, create it
if (!"Offensive_Snaps" %in% colnames(g5_te_week8_2024)) {
  g5_te_week8_2024$Offensive_Snaps <- NA
  cat("Created Offensive_Snaps column with NAs\n")
}

# --- TE Weighted Grading Model (Complete Features) ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (Complete TE Model for G5) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP FEATURES (3X Multiplier) ---
  "Receiving_Yards_after_Contact" = 21.7696558 * 3,
  "Receiving_Touchdowns" = 17.2941714 * 3,
  "Contested_Targets" = 16.2007913 * 3,
  "Offensive_Grade" = 15.6440136 * 3,
  "Snaps_on_Press_Coverage" = 13.4688914 * 3,
  "Yards_per_Route_Run" = 11.9507703 * 3,
  
  # --- NEXT TIER FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Runblock_Grade" = 11.4946460 * 1.5,
  "Passer_Rating_when_Targetted" = 11.3784135 * 1.5,
  "Missed_Tackles_forced_on_Receptions" = 10.4252060 * 1.5,
  "Passblock_Grade" = 9.3267522 * 1.5,
  "Yards_After_Catch_per_Reception" = 8.9767297 * 1.5,
  "Average_Depth_of_Target" = 8.7911050 * 1.5,
  
  # --- REMAINING FEATURES ---
  "Contested_Catches" = 6.0161386,
  "Dropped_Passes" = 4.3571449,
  "Fumbles" = 1.1168613,
  "Fumbles_Lost" = 0.7991708,
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving_Snaps" = 2,
  "Targets" = 20,
  "Receptions" = 50,
  "Receiving_Yards" = 100,
  "Receiving_First_Downs" = 50,
  "Catchable_Targets" = 3,
  "Contested_Catches_Percentage" = 4,
  "Slot_Target_Percentage" = 2,
  "Deep_Target_Percentage" = 3,
  "Completion_Percentage_when_Targeted" = 4,
  "Explosive_Plays" = 6,
  "Percentage_of_Catchable_Passes_Caught" = 3,
  "Dropped_Catchable_Passes_Percentage" = -4,
  "Percentage_of_Targets_per_Receiving_Snaps" = 3,
  
  # --- BLOCKING METRICS (Important for TEs) ---
  "Passblock_Grade" = 50,
  "Runblock_Grade" = 50
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to TE dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(g5_te_week8_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(g5_te_week8_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
te_input_all <- g5_te_week8_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
te_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(te_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(te_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  te_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---
te_full_view <- te_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    Offensive_Grade, Passblock_Grade, Runblock_Grade,
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
te_eval_summary <- te_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== G5 TE WEEK 8 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(te_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(te_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 TEs ===\n")
print(head(te_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(te_eval_summary)
View(te_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats (all columns)
write.csv(
  te_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 8/G5/G5 TE Full Stats Week 8.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet

  te_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 8/G5/G5 TE Week 8 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. G5 TE Full Stats Week 8.csv (ALL stats included)\n")
cat("2. G5 TE Week 8 Grade 2024.csv (Summary with Composite Score & Grade)\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total TEs evaluated:", nrow(te_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---

  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(te_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
  "Dropped_Passes" = 4.3571449,
  "Fumbles" = 1.1168613,
  "Fumbles_Lost" = 0.7991708,
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving_Snaps" = 2,
  "Targets" = 20,
  "Receptions" = 50,
  "Receiving_Yards" = 100,
  "Receiving_First_Downs" = 50,
  "Catchable_Targets" = 3,
  "Contested_Catches_Percentage" = 4,
  "Slot_Target_Percentage" = 2,
  "Deep_Target_Percentage" = 3,
  "Completion_Percentage_When_Targeted" = 4,
  "Explosive_Plays" = 6,
  "Percentage_Of_Catchable_Passes_Caught" = 3,
  "Dropped_Catchable_Passes_Percentage" = -4,
  "Percentage_Of_Targets_Per_Receiving_Snaps" = 3,
  
  # --- BLOCKING METRICS (Important for TEs) ---
  "Pass_Block_Grade" = 50,
  "Run_Block_Grade" = 50
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to TE dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(g5_te_week9_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(g5_te_week9_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
te_input_all <- g5_te_week9_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
te_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(te_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(te_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  te_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View ---
important_features <- names(feature_weights)

# Check correct column names first
cat("Available name columns:", grep("Team", colnames(te_input_all), value = TRUE), "\n")

te_full_view <- te_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    Receiving_Yards, Receiving_Touchdowns, Targets, Receptions,
    any_of(important_features)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
te_eval_summary <- te_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== G5 TE WEEK 9 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(te_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(te_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 TEs ===\n")
print(head(te_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(te_eval_summary)
View(te_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats
write.csv(
  te_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 9/G5/G5 TE Full Stats Week 9.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  te_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 9/G5/G5 TE Week 9 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. G5 TE Full Stats Week 9.csv\n")
cat("2. G5 TE Week 9 Grade 2024.csv\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total TEs evaluated:", nrow(te_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- te_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(te_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(te_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  te_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

  mutate(

      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---

  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    Offensive_Grade, Passblock_Grade, Runblock_Grade,
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))
```

```{r}
# --- TE Weighted Grading Model (Complete Features) ---
```

```{r}
# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (Complete TE Model) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP FEATURES (3X Multiplier) ---
  "Receiving_Yards_after_Contact" = 37.4296314 * 3,
  "Yards_per_Route_Run" = 16.0911051 * 3,
  "Receiving_Touchdowns" = 15.3134390 * 3,

  "Dropped_Catchable_Passes_Percentage" = -4,
  "Percentage_of_Targets_per_Receiving_Snaps" = 3,
  
  # --- BLOCKING METRICS (Important for TEs) ---
  "Passblock_Grade" = 50,
  "Runblock_Grade" = 50
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}
```

```{r}
colnames(offensive_summary_week12_2024)

# First filter for P4 TEs with at least 10 offensive snaps
p4_te_week12_2024 <- te_combined_week12_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "P4", 
         Position == "TE", 
         Offensive_Snaps > 10)

cat("Number of TEs after filtering:", nrow(p4_te_week12_2024), "\n")
glimpse(p4_te_week12_2024)

# --- Add Offensive Snaps and Grades from Summary ---
te_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week12_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "TE") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive_Snaps, Offensive_Grade, Passblock_Grade, Runblock_Grade)

# Join snaps and grades to TE data
p4_te_week12_2024 <- p4_te_week12_2024 %>%
  left_join(te_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Check if Offensive_Snaps was added and rename if needed
if ("Offensive_Snaps.x" %in% colnames(p4_te_week12_2024)) {
  p4_te_week12_2024 <- p4_te_week12_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive_Snaps = coalesce(Offensive_Snaps.x, Offensive_Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive_Snaps.x, -Offensive_Snaps.y)
}

# If Offensive_Snaps doesn't exist, create it
if (!"Offensive_Snaps" %in% colnames(p4_te_week12_2024)) {
  p4_te_week12_2024$Offensive_Snaps <- NA
  cat("Created Offensive_Snaps column with NAs\n")
}

# --- TE Weighted Grading Model (Complete Features) ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (Complete TE Model) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP FEATURES (3X Multiplier) ---
  "Receiving_Yards_after_Contact" = 37.4296314 * 3,
  "Yards_per_Route_Run" = 16.0911051 * 3,
  "Receiving_Touchdowns" = 15.3134390 * 3,
  "Offensive_Grade" = 14.6816592 * 3,
  "Contested_Catches" = 14.5988965 * 3,
  "Missed_Tackles_forced_on_Receptions" = 14.5508964 * 3,
  
  # --- NEXT TIER FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Snaps_on_Press_Coverage" = 13.6860371 * 1.5,
  "Passblock_Grade" = 12.5353405 * 1.5,
  "Average_Depth_of_Target" = 12.3696757 * 1.5,
  "Runblock_Grade" = 12.0060564 * 1.5,
  "Passer_Rating_when_Targetted" = 11.0593491 * 1.5,
  "Yards_After_Catch_per_Reception" = 10.6142461 * 1.5,
  
  # --- REMAINING FEATURES ---
  "Dropped_Passes" = 7.4734004,
  "Fumbles" = 1.9446846,
  "Fumbles_Lost" = 0.8646018,
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving_Snaps" = 2,
  "Targets" = 20,
  "Receptions" = 50,
  "Receiving_Yards" = 100,
  "Receiving_First_Downs" = 50,
  "Catchable_Targets" = 3,
  "Contested_Targets" = 5,
  "Contested_Catches_Percentage" = 4,
  "Slot_Target_Percentage" = 2,
  "Deep_Target_Percentage" = 3,
  "Completion_Percentage_when_Targeted" = 4,
  "Explosive_Plays" = 6,
  "Percentage_of_Catchable_Passes_Caught" = 3,
  "Dropped_Catchable_Passes_Percentage" = -4,
  "Percentage_of_Targets_per_Receiving_Snaps" = 3,
  
  # --- BLOCKING METRICS (Important for TEs) ---
  "Passblock_Grade" = 50,
  "Runblock_Grade" = 50
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to TE dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(p4_te_week12_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(p4_te_week12_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
te_input_all <- p4_te_week12_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
te_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(te_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(te_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  te_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---
te_full_view <- te_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    Offensive_Grade, Passblock_Grade, Runblock_Grade,
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
te_eval_summary <- te_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== P4 TE WEEK 12 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(te_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(te_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 TEs ===\n")
print(head(te_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(te_eval_summary)
View(te_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats (all columns)
write.csv(
  te_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 12/P4/P4 TE Full Stats Week 12.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  te_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 12/P4/P4 TE Week 12 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. P4 TE Full Stats Week 12.csv (ALL stats included)\n")
cat("2. P4 TE Week 12 Grade 2024.csv (Summary with Composite Score & Grade)\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total TEs evaluated:", nrow(te_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- te_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(te_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to TE dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(p4_te_week13_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(p4_te_week13_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
te_input_all <- p4_te_week13_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
te_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(te_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(te_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(te_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  te_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
te_input_all <- te_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---
te_full_view <- te_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    Offensive_Grade, Passblock_Grade, Runblock_Grade,
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
te_eval_summary <- te_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive_Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== P4 TE WEEK 13 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(te_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")

cat("\n=== TOP 10 TEs ===\n")
print(head(te_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(te_eval_summary)
View(te_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats (all columns)
write.csv(
  te_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 13/P4/P4 TE Full Stats Week 13.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  te_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 13/P4/P4 TE Week 13 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. P4 TE Full Stats Week 13.csv (ALL stats included)\n")
cat("2. P4 TE Week 13 Grade 2024.csv (Summary with Composite Score & Grade)\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total TEs evaluated:", nrow(te_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(te_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- te_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(te_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
# --- TE Weighted Grading Model (Complete Features) ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
```
